create_dense_flat_indexer: create a DenseFlatIndexer to build a FAISS flat inner-product index for dense vector retrieval
build_hnsw_flat_indexer: build a DenseHNSWFlatIndexer to construct an approximate nearest neighbor index with HNSW for efficient dense retrieval
create_hnsw_sq_indexer: create a DenseHNSWSQIndexer to build a memory-efficient HNSW scalar-quantized index for large-scale dense retrieval
serialize_index: serialize a FAISS dense indexer to disk with index and metadata files for later deserialization
search_knn_indexer: search a dense FAISS indexer with query vectors to retrieve top-k nearest neighbor document ids and scores
